int_name: E FISHER AVE & N FRONT ST

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks for pedestrians, but lacks essential crossing infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps visible, and parked cars create significant sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the center of the image

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block the visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the intersection

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The environment features a wide residential street with sidewalks on both sides and a marked zebra crosswalk. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and there is a lack of active traffic control or signage to alert drivers to the pedestrian crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: There are no stop signs, signals, or pedestrian warning signs at this crossing point.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt surface within the crossing area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the zebra markings using high-visibility thermoplastic material to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signs or R1-6 in-street signs to clarify right-of-way.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with sidewalks on both sides and a signalized intersection. However, the lack of prominent crosswalk markings, pedestrian signals, and the presence of sightline obstructions from parked cars and vegetation reduce pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street and tall hedges on the left corner may block visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side curb and left foreground corner

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present for vehicles, no pedestrian-specific signals are visible to guide safe crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of center or lane lines on a relatively wide street can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.
